meta.note: All prices are ESTIMATES per night for a family of 2 adults + up to 3 children at standard rates. Holiday/school-holiday pricing will be higher. Always verify on the official website.

properties.name: RACV Noosa Resort
properties.description: Luxury family resort on Noosa Sound — lagoon-style pools, kids' water play area, kids' club, tennis courts, restaurant, bar. 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments with full kitchens. Free shuttle to Hastings Street.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting luxury resort facilities with apartment freedom — lagoon pools and kids' club keep everyone happy.

properties.name: Peppers Noosa Resort & Villas
properties.description: Premium resort nestled in tropical rainforest near Noosa National Park — private villas and apartments with full kitchens, outdoor pools, spa, restaurant, bar. Peaceful luxury within walking distance of Hastings Street.
properties.bestFor: Families who want rainforest seclusion with luxury touches — walk to Hastings Street through the national park.

properties.name: Netanya Noosa Beachfront Resort
properties.description: Absolute beachfront luxury on Noosa Main Beach — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments with stunning ocean views, heated pool, spa, walk directly to Hastings Street and national park. The ultimate Noosa address.
properties.bestFor: Families celebrating a special occasion — absolute Hastings Street beachfront with panoramic ocean views.

properties.name: The Sebel Noosa
properties.description: Apartment hotel in the heart of Noosa — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom self-contained apartments, outdoor pool, close to Hastings Street shops and Noosa Main Beach. Great mid-range option in the best location.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting a central location at mid-range prices — walk everywhere from this Hastings Street apartment base.

properties.name: Noosa Heads Motel & Holiday Apartments
properties.description: Great-value motel apartments near Noosa Junction — studio, 1 and 2 bedroom self-contained apartments, outdoor pool, BBQ area, short walk to shops and restaurants. Walk or bus to Hastings Street.
properties.bestFor: Budget-conscious families — the cheapest solid option near Noosa with full kitchen and pool.

properties.name: Noosa Springs Golf Resort & Spa
properties.description: Resort apartments on Noosa's championship golf course — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom self-contained apartments with full kitchens, outdoor pool, spa, restaurants. Peaceful setting near Noosa's waterways.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting a quieter resort setting near Noosaville's waterfront dining — golf, pool, and serenity.

properties.name: Outrigger Little Hastings Street Resort & Spa
properties.description: Luxury apartment resort just behind Hastings Street — 1, 2 & 3 bedroom apartments with full kitchens, heated lagoon pool, day spa, tropical gardens. Steps from Noosa Main Beach but tucked away in peace.
properties.bestFor: Families wanting to be steps from Hastings Street while enjoying resort tranquillity — hidden luxury behind the main strip.

properties.name: Noosa Blue Resort
properties.description: Boutique apartment resort near Noosa Junction — 1 & 2 bedroom self-contained apartments, designer pool with cabanas, tropical gardens, walk to shops, cafes, and bus to Hastings Street. Stylish on a budget.
properties.bestFor: Style-conscious families on a budget — designer pool, full kitchen, and walk to Noosa Junction's food scene.

properties.name: Sofitel Noosa Pacific Resort
properties.description: Noosa’s grand 5-star resort on Hastings Street — lagoon pool with swim-up bar, day spa, and Main Beach across the road. The classic Noosa luxury stay.

properties.name: RACV Noosa Resort
properties.description: Sprawling family resort in Noosaville — huge lagoon pool with waterslide, kids’ water play zone, school-holiday kids activities, and self-contained villas with full kitchens.
properties.bestFor: The best family-resort setup in Noosa — waterslide, space, and kitchens.

properties.name: Ivory Palms Resort Noosaville
properties.description: Family resort with three pools, a waterslide, jumping pillow, playground and games room — self-contained townhouses and apartments with full kitchens.
properties.bestFor: Budget family resort with a waterslide and big units.
